operator_io_quirks: All tables/columns are lowercase, no spaces; identifiers still need double-quoting (e.g. "type", "contract").
Tiny DB (max 86 rows in roysched); read_schema row sampling is a no-op here, full read is cheap.

DATETIME columns (hire_date, pubdate, ord_date) store TEXT like '1991-10-26 00:00:00.0' — declared type dispatches to Date|Number(int elements) branch; first element is not int so Date fuzzer, but template must parse the 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.0' form.
pub_info.logo is BLOB but storage class is text (hex strings '0x4749...'); declared BLOB dispatches to String fuzzer, not blob branch.
discounts has NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must handle empty PK (no dedup).
roysched has NO primary key either; same empty-PK path.
Composite PKs: sales(stor_id,ord_num,title_id), titleauthor(au_id,title_id) — composite-PK members get max_l0=30 cap.

FK employee.pub_id -> publishers.pub_id, but employee.pub_id samples include '9999','9952' not in publishers (8 rows) — dangling child values exist in original; FK fill must draw from parent's generated values, not original.
discounts.stor_id has null_rate 0.667 and only value '8042' (not in stores) — FK column mostly NULL, single non-null dangling value.
authors.contract has distinct=1 ('0') — String fuzzer will see one element; int-like string '0' triggers +1/-1 neighbors ('1','-1').
employee.minit has empty-string sample '' — String fuzzer length range includes 0.
titles.type has 'UNDECIDED' mixed with lowercase enum values — case-sensitive string comparisons matter.
operator_ts_expectations: String fuzzer for all TEXT columns: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0-20 plus contaminate; names/phones/cities become gibberish — drives FN on queries filtering real names (e.g. 'White', 'CA').

Date fuzzer on hire_date/pubdate/ord_date: template from first parsable element likely '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.0' or similar; range 1800-2100 if <2 distinct parsed — dates scatter widely, breaking year/month predicates (e.g. pubdate in 1991).

Number fuzzer on INTEGER/REAL: full range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from type args (none here -> default), so job_lvl, qty, price, discount get implausible magnitudes — FN on range predicates (qty>50, price<20).
Number list_max quirk: upper end overwritten to full-range max, so even with elements the fresh draws dominate — ties/duplicates rare, FP on GROUP BY / DISTINCT / COUNT(DISTINCT) queries.

String fuzzer on PK columns (au_id, emp_id, title_id, stor_id, pub_id) generates random strings, not the '172-32-1176' / 'BU1032' patterns — joins still work (FK drawn from parent) but literal predicates on PKs fail.

FK fill draws from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement; small parents (publishers=8, stores=6, jobs=14) mean heavy duplication in child FK columns — good for joins, bad for COUNT(DISTINCT pub_id).
Empty-PK tables (discounts, roysched) get no PK dedup; roysched.title_id drawn from titles (18 rows) with replacement -> many duplicate title_id rows, plausible for range joins but inflates counts.
discounts.stor_id mostly NULL in original; TS will draw from stores (6 values) or NULL — changes null_rate, may flip IS NULL predicates.
authors.contract single value '0' -> String fuzzer with 1 element: p=1 path returns element mostly, but contaminate w.p. 0.5 corrupts it — contract='0' predicates become unreliable.
BLOB logo as String: random strings inserted into BLOB column, sqlite stores as text — queries on logo (rare) get type-mismatched results.
No CHECK constraints, no UNIQUE indexes beyond PKs — drop_unique_duplicates only acts on PKs; NOT NULL violations (e.g. NULL in fname) fail at insert and are skipped, shrinking tables.
